No option can be put forward yet, because the model could not assess your requirement of monthly churn **<4%**.

- The price scenarios were compared and the ordering held up under the tested perturbations, but that is not a check that any scenario meets the churn limit.
- The model treats the goal as “higher MRR is better”; that direction was assumed rather than explicitly stated. It also cannot yet translate the £20k/month target into the analysis’s comparison frame.
- The comparison rests partly on Olumi estimates, notably Pro subscriber base, new Pro sign-ups, monthly churn, and feature-release value—not recorded measurements.

A current analysis needs churn represented on a measurable, compatible basis before it can answer your full question.
